title: Off to Indiana today
excerpt: I’d love to see you … I’ll be in Anderson at noon … info here. Then in Marion at 2:15 … Clarence Faulkner Community Center, 1221 W 12th Street. I’ll be leading discussions about faith and values in the presidential campaign, in support of Senator Obama.
body:
I’d love to see you …

I’ll be in Anderson at noon … info here.

Then in Marion at 2:15 … Clarence Faulkner Community Center, 1221 W 12th Street.

I’ll be leading discussions about faith and values in the presidential campaign, in support of Senator Obama.
